additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401744-DC/Si-D/BE [MP / R6 170002120] Outlet 1 out of order CRM:01410001412
additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë D'hose,
I can see in the logs that at around 10:58 AM, a charging session was initiated on the DC1. However, as soon as the charging session was initiated, we receive a log which shows the CP state going from A→B2→E, with a message that the EV got disconnected. After, this, the user tried initiating the charging session again, but the CP1 shows out of order.
We suspect that this has happened from the EV side itself, it could be that the plug was not correctly inserted into the CV, resulting in the issue.
The last charging session on CP1 appeared on 8:25 AM which was a successful session. After that we see charging sessions 13:30 and 19:21 for CP1. CP2 appears to be working fine as multiple charging sessions at 8:21 AM, 10:46 AM and 11:20 AM.
Please let us know if this answers your query. If the issue appears again, we will do a further deeper dive in the logs and find out the reason.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
